purpose: Exact fixed certificate for W022 section B identities and gcd scope. Not a speed, success-rate, or scaling experiment. Single execution, no reruns or tuning.
label_policy: Prime labels are used ONLY by the verifier to check predictions. The selector value gcd(C((N-3)/2,(N-3)/4),N) is computed from N alone. Labels p=the 3 mod 4 prime, q=the 1 mod 4 prime, not ordered by size.

predictions_frozen.P1_semiprime_N3mod4: q | C(2m,m) always; p | C(2m,m) iff p | C((q-1)/2,(q-1)/4); hence gcd in {q,N}, and =q whenever q<2p.
predictions_frozen.P2_derivative: H_n(-1)=0 and H_n'(-1)=(-1)^m n C(2m,m) as exact integers (checked for N<=700 semiprime cases).
predictions_frozen.P3_lucas: Termwise C(n,j)^2 == C(n mod l, j mod l)^2 * C(n//l, j//l)^2 mod l for l in {p,q} (checked for N<=400 semiprime cases); derivative mod p equals H'_{(p-1)/2}(-1)*H_{(q-1)/2}(-1) mod p and derivative mod q is 0 (all semiprime N3mod4 cases).
predictions_frozen.P4_N1mod4: (N-3)/4 not an integer: selector undefined. Diagnostic analog gcd(C((N-1)/2,(N-1)/4),N): every prime l=3 mod 4 divides it; a prime l=1 mod 4 divides it iff l | C((c-1)/2,(c-1)/4), c=N/l. So Blum pairs give N; balanced 1-1 pairs give 1.
predictions_frozen.P5_general_N3mod4: For every prime l | N: l=1 mod 4 => l | C(2m,m); l=3 mod 4 => l | C(2m,m) iff l | C((N/l-1)/2,(N/l-1)/4).

accounting: One event per charged big-integer operation: math.comb call, multiply, add/subtract, modular reduction, gcd, comparison-of-identity. Output bit width of each math.comb is recorded. math.comb is an exact-integer oracle permitted ONLY for this tiny certificate; its cost is Theta~(N) bits of output for the central coefficient and it is NOT an algorithmic primitive or speed oracle. Python control flow, hashing, I/O not charged. Cooperative cap: if events would exceed the cap, remaining checks are recorded as unstarted.
retention: All cases prepopulated as unstarted; every outcome, mismatch, error, or cap retained. No replacement cases.
